steps.text: Sign in to continue to your account

steps.note: a label picked: W takes typing, H is worked out. The two must not look like the same kind of thing
H just took a click: the line under the fields must have swapped the caption for the reason H takes nothing
a locked layer: all four numbers are worked out, so the whole block must read as a readout and the caption must be back to saying it is locked
an arrow: X and Y take typing, W and H have no number at all. The blank pair must not look like two empty boxes waiting for a number
the blank W took a click: it must answer too, not just the ones with a number in them
